title: Feasibility and Acceptability of the Technology Based Enhanced Gender Support Platform Implementation With Parents
official: Feasibility and Acceptability of the Technology Based Enhanced Gender Support Platform Implementation
summary: This is a small pilot feasibility and acceptability study of implementing a Technology-Enhanced Gender Support (TEGS) platform with parents and caregivers. Parents and caregivers who consent to participate will complete an electronic survey at baseline. They will then receive access to the TEGS platform and complete follow up surveys 1 mo and 3 mo after. Each participant will also be given the option to participate in an exit interview.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Parent of a gender diverse youth aged 8-17
* Has access to the internet
* Can speak or read English

Exclusion Criteria:

* Not a parent of a gender diverse youth aged 8-17
* No access to the internet
* Cannot speak or read in English
